detector: cos(2*pi*j/40), with independent Bernoulli endpoint readings
learning_rule: Only prior complete batches enter cubic location and bet; no independent pilot, no use of true mechanism or future records by either sequential policy
acquisition: one independently reset stationary pair per lag per batch; same pre-generated bank for all methods; stopping evaluated on each prefix without exposing future bits
cost: Each complete batch uses3 pairs,6 endpoint readouts,and9/10 expected model-time. Preparation/reset and detector energy are uncalibrated and are not assigned zero cost.
reporting: power/false exclusion with Clopper-Pearson Monte Carlo intervals, capped stopping records and evolution time including non-detections, exact replay checks, failed regimes
